Priya: Heads-up: EU model-v2 cutover planning. Idea: tenant-slice rollout controlled via headers rather than pure random sampling. Start with 10% tenant cohort (high-traffic non-enterprise tenants), shadow 5% of overall traffic for 24h, then expand to 50%/100% if signals are green. Need flag shape, header routing example, rollback gates, and a rough shadow cost estimate.
Miguel: I like header routing for deterministic QA. Suggest we accept X-Redwood-Slice: slice-<id> and X-Redwood-Tenant for per-tenant targeting. That means we can seed specific accounts in preprod and replicate in prod via the header.
Eve: Rollback gates: automated rollback if error_rate > 0.8% sustained 5m OR p95 latency increases by >2x baseline for 10m. Also require manual approval to progress beyond 50% for enterprise tenants.
Sam: For canary selection, pick a mix: 50% by traffic-weighted tenant list + 50% by feature parity list (users who use embeddings + chat). That surfaces both scale and quality regressions.
Kelly: Flag schema proposal: flag_id = "eu_model_v2", attributes = ["rollout_pct", "tenant_allowlist", "slice_header_enabled", "shadow_pct", "warmup_seconds"]. Implement variant metadata so console shows which tenant is on v1/v2.
Priya: Telemetry: capture tags: variant, tenant_id, slice_id, request_path, token_count. Key metrics: error_rate, median latency, p95, token_cost, downstream conversion (if available). Send an audit event for any automated rollback.
Miguel: Operational detail: SRE will add /health?variant=v2 probe returning {version, kv_cache_hit, recent_p95}. K8s liveness/readiness should use variant probes. Also ramp throttles for cold-start: cap qps per instance for first 10m.
Eve: Circuit-breaker: after an automated rollback, open the circuit for 20m and disable automatic re-promotes for 2h. Post-rollcall, we require a single-run validation with a synthetic traffic job.
Sam: Shadowing: implement header X-Redwood-Shadow: true to mirror requests asynchronously to v2. Shadow responses are not returned to users. We will compute embedding cosine drift and rerank delta.
Kelly: Cost note: rough estimate from infra: shadowing 5% of current qps => ~+10% GPU hours for 24h. I'll attach a short calc to the RFC.
DeployBot: job-85543 queued: creating header-based routing rule and flag eu_model_v2@10% applied. Logs: apply-step-1 OK, apply-step-2 queued.
Priya: Action items: 1) Priya to write RFC with thresholds, tenant cohort list, and header examples (due tomorrow 11am). 2) Miguel to add header routing + health-probe changes. 3) Sam to define tenant-sampling script and shadow aggregation queries. 4) Kelly to add flag schema and console slices. 5) Eve to implement circuit-breaker automation + audit logging.
Miguel: Also: let's schedule a 20m sync with SRE and infra to confirm resource limits and synthetic test plan.
Sam: I'll prepare a small eval set (50 prompts) to run on the cohort and collect quality diffs during shadow window.
Priya: Good. If no objections by EOD I'll post the RFC and tag folks. :eyes:
Kelly: ACK
Eve: ACK
